Thanks for joining the torture-fest on **read-model**.

Every variant is measured with the same harness in the same Chrome. Keep your change inside its own module, or the numbers stop meaning anything.

**Size is the DERIVATIVE of your design -- not its driver.**

Not sure your change fits? Read [the README](https://github.com/Mimis-Gildi/read-model#readme) and [the results](https://mimis-gildi.github.io/read-model/), or ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Mimis-Gildi/read-model/discussions).
